description: Start a Mint audio generation lifecycle for a playable sound asset, creating a new Mint chat unless chat_id is supplied. project_id is required when chat_id is absent; when both are supplied they must match. Use audio_kind=sound_effect for SFX, UI sounds, foley, impacts, alerts, transitions, and short ambience. Use audio_kind=general_audio for background music, intro music, lore music, theme music, musical loops, ambience beds, and other non-SFX audio. Audio is final generation only: there is no preview approval, revision, provider/model picker, reference-audio upload, voice cloning, or lyrics workflow in v1. Show chatUrl as the Open in Mint link and keep assetId for get_asset, wait_for_status, get_asset_artifact_manifest, list_asset_artifacts, and get_asset_artifact follow-up. For code-project imports, follow nextSteps through wait_for_status and get_asset_artifact_manifest. Do not expose raw asset ids unless the user asks. If status is billing_required, generationStarted is false: use billing.userMessage as the core user response, explain the account entitlement or credit shortfall without promoting subscriptions, upgrades, or credit purchases, and present billing.chatUrl as a blocked request that can resume after billing is resolved. Do not call it a failed generation.
name: start_audio_generation
title: Start Audio Generation
